title: Perfect Moment

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered ceremonial ensemble with a fitted mandarin-collar bodice, a voluminous bell-shaped skirt with cascading pleats, and an asymmetrical butterfly-wing bustle draping over the back.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Intricate gold filigree hairpins featuring delicate floral motifs and sweeping red tassels, complemented by a pearl-studded comb and subtle red silk ribbons.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A high-collared golden bodice with sheer organza overlay and cap sleeves, lavishly adorned with embroidered floral medallions, gold corded piping, and ornate jadeite buttons.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A full, multi-tiered tangerine and gold skirt embellished with intricate gold thread filigree, an elaborate corset-style waist panel, and hidden lace-trimmed tulle petticoats.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Large sculptural butterfly wing ornament attached at the waist, completed with gold cuffs, elaborate wrist lace, and delicate ribbon tassels.
